summary.zh-CN: 恢复归档会话的工具调用，修复新会话大工具结果崩溃，并兼容旧检查点和异常预览。
summary.en-US: Restore tool calls in archived conversations and fix crashes after large tool results, including older checkpoints and malformed previews.

title.zh-CN: 归档历史不再封禁普通工具
title.en-US: Archived history no longer blocks ordinary tools

body.zh-CN: 当前明确请求可以继续执行，无需统一再次确认。旧恢复检查点也采用这一行为；需要的旧条件和结果仍通过历史核实，不自动重放旧操作。
body.en-US: Current explicit requests can continue without blanket reconfirmation, including sessions with older recovery checkpoints. Necessary earlier facts are verified from history without automatically replaying old actions.

title.zh-CN: 修复大结果与旧预览的崩溃
title.en-US: Fix crashes from large results and older previews

body.zh-CN: 工具结果预览不再破坏内容数组，旧异常字段也能兼容读取。保留原始正文及真实写盘失败保护；Issue #73 原 0.59.1 首次写入异常的根因仍在调查。
body.en-US: Tool previews no longer corrupt content arrays, and older malformed fields are handled. Original content and actual write-failure protection remain intact. The first 0.59.1 write-failure trigger in Issue #73 remains under investigation.
